event_index.definition: 0-based order of detected collapses. Used to plot conditioning.

first_cycle.definition: True when the preceding ramp is much flatter than the later population (startup / long plateau). Kept in the event table; excluded from typical stats.

t_break.definition: Collapse-start time: first sample of the steepest ~20 ns drop. Event timestamp for all intervals; not the 1-sample voltage maximum.

v_breakdown.definition: Median voltage over the ~20-50 ns plateau immediately before t_break. Repetitive breakdown voltage for that shot.

v_undershoot.definition: Minimum in the ~200 ns after t_break. Includes inductive kick / probe ringing.

v_residual.definition: Median voltage after ringing settles (~1-5 us post-edge), at the start of the next charging ramp. Recovery / restart voltage for the next cycle.

dv_collapse.definition: v_breakdown - v_undershoot. Total observed swing including undershoot.

t10.definition: Absolute time of the first 10% crossing on the falling edge.

t90.definition: Absolute time of the first 90% crossing on the falling edge.

t_collapse_10_90.definition: t90 - t10. IEC/scope 10-90% fall time of the discharge edge.

slew_collapse_mean.definition: 0.8 * (v_pre - v_post) / t_collapse_10_90. Mean collapse gradient; a lower bound set by scope bandwidth.

slew_collapse_peak.definition: Maximum |dV/dt| over a 5 ns window on the falling edge.

t_ring.definition: Dominant post-collapse ring period in the 50-400 ns window (median peak spacing of the residual after a short moving mean).

charge_rate.definition: Least-squares slope of the linear charging ramp from residual settle to ~100 ns before t_break. I ≈ C * charge_rate if C is known.

charge_intercept.definition: Intercept of V = a + b t on the charging-ramp fit (for overlays).

charge_r2.definition: Coefficient of determination of the linear ramp fit. Low R² flags a non-linear ramp.

v_charge_start.definition: Voltage at the start of the ramp-fit window.

v_charge_end.definition: Voltage at the end of the ramp-fit window (near v_breakdown).

recovery_s.definition: Time from t_break until a short local slope matches the next-cycle charge rate. Duration of the post-spark transient.

energy_j.definition: 0.5 * C * v_breakdown^2. Only when --capacitance is given.

charge_c.definition: C * (v_breakdown - v_residual). Only when --capacitance is given.

source_current_a.definition: C * charge_rate during the linear ramp. Only when --capacitance is given.

L_est_h.definition: 1 / ((2π / t_ring)^2 * C) if t_ring and C are known.
